characters.description: Doppiatore maschio, 30 anni, intenso, concentrato, con un microfono professionale davanti a lui.
characters.name: Marco

characters.description: Donna di 40 anni, vestita in modo elegante, osserva l'azione dallo schermo del monitor.
characters.name: Regista

locations.description: Spazio acustico isolato con pannelli fonoassorbenti, pannello vetro per il controllo, luci al neon fredde e calde.
locations.name: Studio di Registrazione

locations.description: Stanza arredata con monitor grandi, sedie ergonomiche e cavi che si snodano sul pavimento scuro.
locations.name: Sala Controllo

scenes.action: Marco entra nello studio, toglie la giacca e si sistema al microfono.
scenes.heading: Ingresso nello Studio
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide shot of a soundproof recording studio with acoustic foam panels on walls, a male voice actor entering wearing casual clothes, removing a jacket, standing in front of a professional microphone stand, cool blue ambient lighting mixed with warm practical lights, shallow depth of field.
scenes.motionPrompt: Camera slowly pushes in as the actor enters the frame and removes his jacket.

scenes.action: Marco esegue esercizi di respirazione e suoni gutturali per sciogliere la gola.
scenes.heading: Riscaldamento Vocale
scenes.imagePrompt: Medium close-up of the voice actor's face, steam rising from a cup nearby, mouth open wide making vocal exercises, intense focus in eyes, soft rim lighting highlighting facial contours, slight motion blur on breath particles.
scenes.motionPrompt: Camera tilts up slightly following the movement of his head during vocal warm-ups.

scenes.action: Marco legge ad alta voce guardando il monitor, la regista annuisce soddisfatta.
scenes.heading: Lettura del Copione
scenes.imagePrompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the glass window into the booth, actor reading lines on a script pad, gesturing with hands for emphasis, bright screen glow reflecting on his face, high contrast lighting.
scenes.motionPrompt: Camera pans smoothly from the actor to the reaction of the director visible through the glass.

scenes.action: Marco improvvisa una scena con grande pathos, sudando leggermente per l'adrenalina.
scenes.heading: Prova di Emozione
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme close-up on the actor's eyes and mouth, sweat glistening on forehead, dramatic side lighting creating deep shadows, intense emotional expression, shallow depth of field blurring background equipment.
scenes.motionPrompt: Camera zooms in rapidly to capture the intensity of the performance.

scenes.action: Marco registra la linea perfetta, il regista esclama 'Bene!'.
scenes.heading: Registrazione Finale
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide shot showing both the booth and control room, actor delivering final line with perfect timing, green LED lights on recording equipment blinking, warm spotlight on actor, dynamic composition.
scenes.motionPrompt: Camera tracks slightly left to right following the energy of the final take.

scenes.action: Marco esce dallo studio rilassato, sorride mentre guarda il monitor con l'audio finale.
scenes.heading: Post-Produzione
scenes.imagePrompt: Medium shot of actor walking out of the booth into a hallway, relaxed posture, smiling, holding a water bottle, soft natural light from windows contrasting with studio lights, depth of field focusing on face.
scenes.motionPrompt: Camera follows the actor walking forward with a steady dolly movement.

story.style: Documentario dinamico, illuminazione cinematografica calda e fredda alternata, focus sui dettagli espressivi.
story.synopsis: Un doppiatore professionista si prepara con dedizione ed energia per registrare uno spot pubblicitario, passando dal riscaldamento vocale alla prova del copione fino alla registrazione finale in studio.
story.title: Voce Pronta
